label: Population density (log)
definition: Natural log of 2025 population / GV area; June 2026 boundaries

label: Non-German citizenship (%)
definition: 100 × non-German citizens / demographic population; citizenship is not migration background

label: One-person households (%)
definition: 100 × one-person private households / all private households

label: Owner-occupied dwellings (%)
definition: Published ETQ: owner-occupied / inhabited dwellings in residential buildings excluding dormitories

label: Vacant dwellings (%)
definition: Published LEQ: empty / occupied and empty dwellings in residential buildings excluding dormitories

label: Net cold rent (EUR/m²)
definition: Published mean dwelling-level rent per m²; rental dwellings in residential buildings excluding dormitories and rent-free dwellings

label: Abitur/Fachhochschulreife (%)
definition: 100 × persons with university entrance qualification / persons aged 15+ in sampled household population

label: No vocational qualification (%)
definition: 100 × persons without vocational qualification / persons aged 15+ in sampled household population

label: ILO unemployment (%)
definition: 100 × unemployed / labour force in census household sample; not registered BA unemployment

label: Manufacturing employment (%)
definition: 100 × employed residents in manufacturing / all employed residents in census household sample
